200.description:
Search the JLCPCB parts library. Accepts a free-text keyword (description words, an LCSC C-number such as C5358, or a manufacturer part number such as STM32F103C8T6) and/or a category, with optional manufacturer, package, availability tab, basic/extended and sort filters. Returns one page of parts with stock, assembly and purchase price breaks (USD), package, type, attributes, datasheet and canonical URLs. Keyword matching is fuzzy on the source: an unknown C-number still returns similar parts, so `exact_match` marks rows whose C-number or MPN equals the query.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `parts` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `assembly_prices` | object[] | Price breaks for assembly (source componentPrices). |
| `attributes` | object[] |  |
| `attrition_qty` | number | Source lossNumber: units JLCPCB adds for assembly attrition. |
| `category` | string | Top-level category. |
| `component_code` | string | LCSC part number (C-number); the identifier get_part takes. |
| `datasheet_url` | string | Stable LCSC datasheet PDF link when the source has one. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `exact_match` | boolean | True when the query equals this part's C-number or MPN (case-insensitive). |
| `lcsc_url` | string |  |
| `library_type` | string | JLCPCB assembly library type: basic (source `base`) or extended (source `expand`). |
| `manufacturer` | string |  |
| `min_assembly_qty` | number | Source leastPatchNumber: minimum placement quantity per order. |
| `min_order_qty` | number | Source minPurchaseNum. |
| `mpn` | string | Manufacturer part number (source componentModelEn). |
| `package` | string | Package / footprint string (source componentSpecificationEn). |
| `preferred` | boolean | Preferred Extended part flag. |
| `purchasable` | boolean | Source isBuyComponent: the part can be bought through JLCPCB's global sourcing. |
| `purchase_prices` | object[] | Price breaks for purchase without assembly (source buyComponentPrices), sorted by min_qty. |
| `reel_qty` | number | Source encapsulationNumber: units per full reel/package. |
| `rohs` | boolean |  |
| `stock` | number | JLCPCB stock count at observation time. |
| `subcategory` | string | Second-level category (source componentTypeEn). |
| `url` | string | Canonical JLCPCB part detail page. |
